en: Black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined street or promenade beside a row of multi‑storey residential buildings with steep, gabled roofs and small balconies. The buildings have an early 20th‑century Central European look. On the left, a person pushes a pram along a path bordered by tall leafless trees and low fences, with open fields or parkland and a distant house in the background. The scene feels quiet and suburban. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
